messages:
maya: thinking out loud — we keep getting ask from product to show which service account delegations are eating quota in the console. right now billing + quota charts just show org/project, but not the SA that delegated. can we add a low-cardinality tag on quota events for the delegating SA? :thinking:

jin: +1 to visibility. main concern = cardinality explosion if we start surface raw SA ids in metrics. also privacy/compliance for customer-owned SA names. suggestion: add an opaque hashed tag (e.g. sa_tag) that maps to friendly names only in the console for orgs that opt-in.

oliver: curious about how this fits with sampling. we already sample request telemetry at 1% for cost reasons — if we attach sa_tag only on sampled events, the charts might undercount. maybe we do dense counting for quota-metering pipeline (non-sampled) but emit a lightweight tag for analytics events.

maya: right — proposal sketch: 
1) attach `sa_tag` to quota-metering records (backend-only, stored in billing pipeline). `sa_tag` = sha256(org_id + sa_id + salt) first 12 hex chars.
2) in the console, show top-k delegating SAs by mapping `sa_tag` -> display_name for orgs that enable the feature. mapping kept in org-scoped KV (encrypted).
3) do not expose raw sa_id in metrics; only the mapping service can resolve the tag (requires admin access).

pranav: sounds reasonable. couple questions: how do we handle ephemeral delegations (ephemeral tokens from ephemeral SAs) and rotation? also retention policy for the mapping store?

jin: ephemeral tokens — still include the parent SA id in the event when possible. but if parent is ephemeral (one-shot), tag maps to `ephemeral:<short-id>`; we treat those as low-value and collapse them into `ephemeral` bucket in UI. retention: default 90 days for mapping + 30 days in aggregated metrics. longer retention behind enterprise flag.

oliver: implementation notes: upstream ingress proxy needs to populate `X-Del-Sa` header (or set our internal claim) so metering can compute tag. billing pipeline will need a small transform stage that computes the truncated sha and increments the SA counters.

maya: example event payload we were thinking about (billing side):
```json
{
  "org_id": "org-123",
  "project_id": "proj-7",
  "tokens": 342,
  "timestamp": 1766019988,
  "sa_tag": "a3f4c8d2b9e1",
  "delegate_type": "service_account"
}
```

sarah: telemetry/compliance note: any mapping store must be encrypted and access-controlled. product wants searchable names in console — we should make sure that search queries go to a service that checks org-level permission before resolving tag->name. also add an audit log entry whenever mapping is created/rotated. :lock:

telemetry-bot: FYI — adding new `sa_tag` dimension will increase metrics shards. ops estimate ~+6% storage. okay to proceed if we add rollout guard and toggle.

pranav: rollout plan idea: feature-flag behind `sa_delegation_visibility`, start with internal orgs + 2 customer canaries. monitoring: compare quota attribution pre/post over first 48h for skew. fallback: if mapping store latency >500ms, console shows tag-only view (no name resolve).

oliver: dev work: 
- ingress proxy change (1 w)
- billing transform stage (2 w)
- mapping service (1 w) + auth checks
- console UI changes (1 w)
- e2e tests + canary (1 w)
Estimate ~6w total but splitable across teams.

maya: thanks. decision: jin/pranav to draft prod PR with schema change + rollout flag. oliver to sketch billing transform. sarah to write compliance checklist. I'll book a 30m sync tomorrow to align canary orgs. :calendar: :eyes:

jin: will start PR, tagging @oliver @sarah.

oliver: noted. I'll put a prototype transform in a branch this week.

sarah: will draft checklist and share in this thread.

maya: awesome — closing loop. if anyone has objections to hashing approach speak now. otherwise we'll move to RFC next week.
